summary: Ord. 2026-06 deletes computer/data storage centers as permitted principal uses in the R-O, R-O2 and I-O zones through 2027-12-31, when it sunsets unless extended.
notes: Ordinance text (township site) is primary but its adoption block is blank; Princeton Perspectives (2026-07-15) says council approved it "last month", so adoption ~June 2026, exact date not found (2026 minutes posted only through March). Takes effect 20 days after final passage. Existing QTS data center site in township.

summary: County ordinance pauses acceptance, processing and approval of data-center-related applications through 2026-12-31 while a 13-member study committee reviews impacts.
notes: Area Plan Commission approved 2026-08-06; commissioners adopted between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-27 (exact date not found). Committee to vote recommendations 2026-12-15.

summary: Supervisors voted 4-1 to extend the 45-day urgency moratorium to 2028-08-21 and exempt facilities drawing under 3 MW, while staff drafts a permanent data center ordinance.
notes: Article dated 2026-10-06 says vote was Tuesday, i.e. 2026-10-06. Original ordinance (2026-09-01) would have expired 2026-10-16. Upstream sectors include crypto mining; extension coverage of crypto not stated.

summary: Council approved second reading of a one-year moratorium on applications for data centers, data processing and crypto mining on 2026-09-21; third and final reading set for the next meeting.
notes: Upstream calls 2026-09-21 the unanimous third reading. Local paper (via AOL) says it was second reading; first reading 2026-09-08 invoked pending-ordinance doctrine, so the pause is enforced in practice. WTOC headline reads as final approval.

summary: Village Council voted 6-0 to establish a temporary moratorium on data centers through 2026-11-17 while the Planning Commission refines proposed zoning provisions.
notes: Citizen Portal (AI summary of meeting record). Outside the 2026-09-20 window but missing upstream.

summary: Town Board adopted a 90-day local-law moratorium on new cryptocurrency mining operations (to 2021-11-30), later extended twice while it drafted crypto mining regulations.
notes: WWNY 2022-02-17 read: extension to 2022-04-30 (unanimous). Original Aug 2021 adoption (hearing 2021-08-04) and Nov 30 / Jan 31 dates from NNY360 headlines/snippets (site rate-limited). Final regulation adoption date not confirmed. Separate from Massena Electric Department utility row.

summary: City Council voted 4-1 for an immediately effective moratorium on new data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities until 2022-06-15; later extended to 2022-09-13.
notes: WKBW article read (undated on page; Buffalo News follow-up is Dec 2021). Exact adoption day not found (about 2021-12-15). Extension to 2022-09-13 from search summary only; regulations (noise) followed in 2022. Status after extension assumed expired/replaced.
